C-NOTIFICATION-SYSTEM.IntentSummary: One Vue-rendered notification card (icon-chip, four severities, theme tokens) with a single bottom-right stack (cap 3 + overflow chip, hover-pause, sticky errors, Esc), copy-on-select confirmed only by a double green pulse, typed actions[] replacing showConfirm, severity x source events with dedupKey collapsing, session history behind a palette command, the C-66 update notice and the per-file banner joining the same visual family, and the dead SHOW_PANDOC_MISSING path removed — with graph/verification deltas and visual probe evidence.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: All 34 *.theme.css files define --notifyInfo, --notifySuccess, --notifyWarning, --notifyError. Paper (#3D6AD6 / #2F9E63 / #C46510 / #D5453C) and Ink (#82A9F7 / #6BCB90 / #F5A83C / #F87A72) are normative from the approved mock; other themes are tuned to their palettes keeping readable contrast against their --floatBg in both light and dark families. No component hardcodes a severity color literal.

Verification.Command: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const g=require('glob');const files=fs.readdirSync('src/renderer/src/assets/themes').filter(f=>f.endsWith('.theme.css'));const need=['--notifyInfo','--notifySuccess','--notifyWarning','--notifyError'];let bad=[];for(const f of files){const t=fs.readFileSync('src/renderer/src/assets/themes/'+f,'utf8');for(const n of need)if(!t.includes(n))bad.push(f+':'+n)}console.log(files.length+' themes');if(bad.length){console.error(bad.join('\n'));process.exit(1)}"

T-002.Title: Notification store, card and stack (the system core)

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: store/notifications.js (pinia) owns the stack and the history: NOTIFY({severity, source, title, message, actions, dedupKey, sticky, time}) with severity default info and the legacy type value primary mapped to info (unknown types fall back to info, never throw); BLOCK_NOTIFY_DEDUP collapses a repeat under a live card with the same dedupKey into a visible xN counter (max width-safe formatting) while history still appends one entry per occurrence; BLOCK_NOTIFY_HISTORY_APPEND logs {time, severity, source, title, fullText} capped at 50 FIFO; stack keeps at most 3 live cards plus an overflow chip entry; DISMISS(id), DISMISS_TOP (Esc), hover-pause flag. actions[]: entries {kind:'copy'|'retry'|'open'|'reveal', payload} or {label, handler}; rendering styles primary/normal/quiet; clicking an action never resolves anything promise-like. components/notificationCard/index.vue renders one card: icon-chip (chromeIcons 16-grid glyph in a 14%-tint circle via color-mix on the severity token), C-66 metrics (radius 12, floatBg, floatShadow+floatBorder ring, max-width 320), title 14/600 editorColor, message floatFont user-select:text, close x, source label, timer hairline for auto-dismiss severities (none for sticky errors), role=status aria-live=polite. BLOCK_COPY_ON_SELECT: mouseup/touchend with a non-empty selection contained in the card copies exactly the selection (navigator.clipboard with try/catch silent no-op), plays the double green pulse on the selection (two ~250ms pulses in ~1.1s, class removed on animationend, none under prefers-reduced-motion), and does NOT dismiss; an empty-selection click on the card body dismisses. components/notificationStack/index.vue renders the ordered stack (10px gaps, bottom-right, z-index under modal scrims) + the overflow chip with per-locale plurals, mounts Esc handling without stealing editor focus. services/notification/index.js becomes a compatibility facade: default export keeps notify/clear call shape for all ~70 existing imports, forwarding to the store, plus the new optional fields; index.html template file and index.css are deleted; DOM-string rendering, the fluent effect and rePositionNotices JS math are gone. MODULE_CONTRACT/MAP/CHANGE_SUMMARY on every touched module; no .mt-notification markup anywhere.

components/notificationsHistory/index.vue opens from command view.notifications-history (registered in commands/index.js without a shortcut, described in descriptions.js via a new locale key) and lists session history newest-first: time, source label, severity icon, full untruncated text (no clamping), and a per-entry copy action (copy icon + label, clipboard write with the same silent no-op rule); empty state message localized. The dialog never persists state and is mountable multiple times. Mounted from pages/app.vue beside the command palette.

T-004.Title: Store passthrough, dead code removal, call-site migrations, locales

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: store/notification.js SHOW_NOTIFICATION forwards the new optional fields (source, actions, dedupKey, sticky) and maps type to severity; SHOW_PANDOC_MISSING is deleted. store/editor.js: the image-deletion-URL notice becomes an actions[] copy entry (button copies deletionUrl to the clipboard; no promise chain); the export-success reveal notice becomes an actions[] reveal entry (showItemInFolder on click). No showConfirm caller or field remains anywhere (grep-pinned in tests). installPandoc keys removed from all ten static/locales/*.json and the .min.json files are regenerated by the existing locale pipeline; new keys land as native copy in all ten locales: palette/history labels (title, empty state, copy action), source names (file/export/project/update/agent/system), overflow chip plural forms, built-in action labels (Copy/Retry/Open/Reveal).

The card sits in the same stack z-order family; no separate fixed positioning remains.

C-1.Name: Stack overflow and plurals
C-1.Expected: Five quick notifies show exactly 3 cards plus an overflow chip reading "More 2 notifications" in English and the correct Russian plural form; reopening the history lists all five in order.

C-2.Name: Sticky errors, hover pause, Esc
C-2.Expected: An error card never auto-dismisses and shows no timer hairline; hovering a timed card pauses its hairline and dismissal until the pointer leaves; Esc closes only the topmost card; Esc never moves focus out of the editor.

C-3.Name: Selection release vs dismissal
C-3.Expected: Press-drag-release inside a card copies the selection and leaves the card open; a click on the card body with no selection dismisses it; the close x always dismisses.

C-4.Name: Clipboard unavailable
C-4.Expected: If navigator.clipboard rejects or is absent, the copy silently no-ops: no error notice, no console throw, the card stays, the pulse still plays.

C-5.Name: Dedup storm
C-5.Expected: Ten notifies with one dedupKey within a second render one card whose counter climbs to x10 while the history holds ten entries; a notify without dedupKey never collapses.

C-6.Name: Legacy call-shape compatibility
C-6.Expected: Every pre-existing notify({title,message,type,time}) call still works: type primary maps to info, unknown or missing type falls back to info, time 0 or absent uses severity defaults; none of the ~70 call sites is edited except the two migrated in T-004.

C-7.Name: showConfirm is gone, shortcuts remain
C-7.Expected: The two migrated call sites act as one-click buttons (copy URL, reveal in Finder) with no dangling promise or rejection path; no code path resolves or rejects on notification clicks anywhere.

C-8.Name: Update notice semantics frozen
C-8.Expected: After migration, Update installs via INSTALL_UPDATE, Later dismisses, Skip persists the skip through SKIP_VERSION; the notice still shows at most once per launch and never flashes during boot races; the C-66 archive contract text stays the semantic owner.

C-9.Name: Parallel-session coexistence
C-9.Expected: Graph and verification edits are additive; the parallel sessions' uncommitted edits in .grace/graph/runtime.xml, .grace/verification/runtime.xml, commands/index.js and the 28 pre-existing lint errors are untouched; grace lint gains zero findings that reference this change's files.

C-10.Name: Reduced motion
C-10.Expected: Under prefers-reduced-motion: no pulse, no hairline animation, no card transitions; timers still fire; copy-on-select still copies; the overflow chip still appears.

C-11.Name: Severity tokens across 34 themes
C-11.Expected: Every theme defines all four severity tokens; pixel probes on Paper and Ink match the approved mock (chip tint ~14% of severity over floatBg); no severity color literal exists in any component.
